method: Conservative full-text review requiring Luke's parable of the rich man and Lazarus to be a primary or major sustained subject of each post.

topic.name: Rich Man and Lazarus
topic.description: Examines Luke's parable of the rich man and Lazarus, including its treatment of wealth and poverty, postmortem reversal, Hades, possible Egyptian parallels, and whether the story originated with Jesus.
